jobAdDetails.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobAdDetails.description:
Sapiens is looking for a Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer to join our Corporate IT / Infrastructure team. You will design, build, remediate, and improve Sapiens’ corporate Azure infrastructure, translating target architectures and security standards into reliable production solutions. You will also act as hands-on delivery partner and technical deputy to the Lead Azure Infrastructure Engineer.
If you are a senior cloud infrastructure professional who wants deep technical ownership across Azure landing zones, networking, Entra ID/AD integration, and automation, this role offers direct influence over the corporate Azure foundation.

Location: Bengaluru
Working Model: Our flexible work arrangement combines both remote and in-office work, optimizing flexibility and productivity. 

What you’ll do:
The role is responsible for designing, deploying, remediating, and improving Sapiens’ corporate Azure infrastructure. The scope is corporate Azure only (non-product and non-customer environments). The ideal candidate is a senior technical specialist who takes difficult engineering work end to end, from design through handover and operations.

Key Responsibilities
Azure infrastructure engineering
•  Design, deploy, and troubleshoot management groups, subscriptions, virtual networks, routing, DNS, private endpoints, connectivity, compute, storage, and other corporate Azure services.
•  Implement and improve landing-zone configurations, Azure Policy initiatives, RBAC, tagging, resource standards, and environment guardrails based on agreed architecture.
•  Investigate and remediate security and configuration gaps, and raise architectural decisions that require the Lead Engineer’s approval.
Identity, security, and transformation
•  Implement and troubleshoot Entra ID and Active Directory integrations, synchronization, authentication, access provisioning, and related security controls.
•  Own assigned identity rationalization migration work packages, including dependency analysis, automation, testing, cutover, rollback procedures, and post-migration validation.
•  Implement least-privilege access, Conditional Access, privileged access processes, secrets and certificate practices, logging, and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with the CISO team.
Automation, delivery, and operational readiness
•  Create and maintain infrastructure-as-code modules and automation using Terraform or Bicep, PowerShell, and Git-based engineering practices.
•  Review HSO and internal implementation outputs for corporate Azure, identity, and Dynamics 365 integration dependencies, and escalate unresolved design risks.
•  Partner with the Cloud Engineer on complex incidents, root-cause analysis, performance, monitoring, backup and recovery, and operational improvements. Produce useful runbooks and diagrams.
•  Coordinate deployment interfaces and shared automation standards with the application DevOps team, without assuming ownership of application pipelines or the IDP.

Must Have Skills
•  7+ years of relevant infrastructure experience, including substantial hands-on engineering with enterprise Microsoft Azure.
•  Strong Azure networking, subscription and management group, landing-zone configuration, policy, RBAC, logging, and platform security experience.
•  Practical implementation experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and hybrid identity, with confidence troubleshooting identity and access failures.
•  Hands-on PowerShell plus Terraform or Bicep, with a good understanding of Git, change control, and repeatable deployment approaches.
•  Experience diagnosing complex cloud incidents, managing production changes, and delivering documented solutions from design through operations.
•  Ability to execute technical work independently, challenge assumptions, and mentor engineers while operating within approved architecture.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104). Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Security/Identity certifications are advantageous.
•  Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics/KQL, Defender for Cloud, backup and recovery, and cost optimization.
•  Experience supporting Dynamics 365-related infrastructure integrations or supplier-managed transformation programs.

What We Are Looking For
A senior, hands-on Azure infrastructure engineer who combines deep technical implementation skills with engineering leadership. You will be accountable for the detailed delivery and technical quality of assigned infrastructure changes. You will contribute architecture options, while the Lead Engineer holds overall authority for the corporate Azure target state and identity design. You will also provide technical escalation and coaching to the Cloud Engineer.
You will work closely with the Lead Azure Infrastructure Engineer, Azure Cloud Engineer, CISO and Security team, enterprise application owners, HSO, and the DevOps/Platform Engineering team.

Position Success
•  Agreed priority Azure gaps are closed, with tested configurations and change evidence.
•  Identity migration work packages are completed successfully, with dependency and rollback documentation.
•  Version-controlled IaC and reusable deployment patterns are used more widely for corporate Azure changes.
•  Recurring incidents and configuration drift are reduced, and operational handover quality improves.
•  Design decisions translate into secure, supportable production infrastructure.
•  Reporting line, employment location, grade, and operational coverage are to be confirmed through Sapiens’ hiring process.

About Sapiens:
Sapiens is a global leader in the insurance industry, delivering its award-winning, cloud-based SaaS insurance platform to over 600 customers in more than 30 countries. Sapiens’ platform offers pre-integrated, low-code capabilities to accelerate customers’ digital transformation. With more than 40 years of industry expertise, Sapiens has a highly professional team of over 5,000 employees globally. 
For More information visit us on www.sapiens.com. 
  
Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment that embraces individuals from diverse backgrounds. 
 
Disclaimer: Sapiens India does not authorise any third parties to release employment offers or conduct recruitment drives via a third party. Hence, beware of inauthentic and fraudulent job offers or recruitment drives from any individuals or websites purporting to represent Sapiens . Further, Sapiens does not charge any fee or other emoluments for any reason (including without limitation, visa fees) or seek compensation from educational institutions to participate in recruitment events. Accordingly, please check the authenticity of any such offers before acting on them and where acted upon, you do so at your own risk. Sapiens shall neither be responsible for honouring or making good the promises made by fraudulent third parties, nor for any monetary or any other loss incurred by the aggrieved individual or educational institution.  
In the event that you come across any fraudulent activities in the name of Sapiens , please feel free report the incident at sapiens to sharedservices@sapiens.com.

jobAdDetails.title: Network Systems Engineer
jobAdDetails.description:
Sapiens is looking for a Network Systems Specialist to join our Development / Infrastructure team. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure across LAN, WAN, VPCs, routing, firewalls, and connectivity solutions. You will help ensure reliable and secure data flow across Sapiens’ geographically distributed multi-cloud and legacy environments.
If you are an experienced network engineering professional with strong expertise in cloud and hybrid networking, network security, multi-region connectivity, and infrastructure resilience, this role offers an opportunity to contribute to Sapiens’ global network infrastructure.

Location: Bengaluru
Working Model: Our flexible work arrangement combines both remote and in-office work, optimizing flexibility and productivity.

What you'll do:
You will take ownership of network engineering activities across cloud and hybrid environments, ensuring secure connectivity, network availability, performance, and resilience. The role involves designing and maintaining network configurations, troubleshooting complex connectivity issues, supporting cloud migrations, and improving network standards across multiple environments.

Key Responsibilities
Network Infrastructure Engineering
•  Design, configure, and maintain LAN/WAN, VPCs, and cloud networking configurations, including routing protocols, subnet architectures, and security group rules in alignment with established cloud architecture standards.
•  Configure and maintain network security controls, including firewall rules, VPN configurations, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute connectivity, and network security zone boundaries.
•  Ensure secure data transmission between cloud environments, legacy systems, and client connectivity points.
Network Monitoring, Security, and Performance
•  Monitor network performance and availability using network monitoring tools to identify latency, packet loss, bandwidth saturation, and routing anomalies.
•  Troubleshoot network-layer incidents and ensure timely resolution within defined SLA requirements.
•  Identify network security and configuration gaps and implement improvements to strengthen network reliability and security.
Cloud Connectivity and Migration Support
•  • Support cloud migration initiatives by provisioning VPCs and connectivity for target cloud environments.
•  • Configure network integration bridges between legacy and cloud-native environments.
•  • Validate network connectivity and configurations during migration activities to ensure smooth transition and service continuity.
Network Documentation and Continuous Improvement
•  • Maintain network documentation, including topology diagrams, VPC architecture maps, routing tables, firewall rule sets, and connectivity specifications.
•  • Ensure network configurations are properly documented and version-controlled, following established change-management practices.
•  • Evaluate and recommend network infrastructure improvements, including capacity upgrades, resilience enhancements, and connectivity optimization based on performance monitoring and evolving business requirements.

Must Have Skills
•  Strong hands-on experience in network engineering, including LAN, WAN, cloud networking, and hybrid connectivity.
•  Good understanding of VPC architecture, subnetting, routing protocols, network security groups, and network segmentation.
•  Practical experience configuring and managing firewalls, VPNs, and secure network connectivity.
•  Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud networking environments and connectivity between cloud and legacy infrastructure.
•  Strong troubleshooting skills in identifying and resolving network performance, availability, and connectivity issues.
•  Experience with network monitoring tools, network documentation, configuration management, and change-control processes.
•  Ability to independently manage network engineering deliverables, resolve complex technical challenges, and coordinate with cross-functional infrastructure and security teams.
•  Preferred Qualifications
•  Relevant networking certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, AWS Advanced Networking, or Azure Network Engineer Associate.
•  Experience with AWS VPC, Azure Virtual Network, AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and hybrid connectivity solutions.
•  Familiarity with network automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and version-controlled network configurations.
•  Experience supporting multi-region cloud environments and large-scale cloud migration programmes.

What We Are Looking For
A Senior Network Systems Specialist who combines strong network engineering expertise with the ability to manage cross-environment connectivity, security, and resilience. The ideal candidate should be capable of independently handling complex network challenges, improving network architecture implementation standards, and coordinating with infrastructure, security, and migration stakeholders.
You will be expected to take ownership of significant network engineering workstreams, contribute to network design improvements, and ensure the integrity of network configurations and documentation across multiple environments.
You will work closely with Cloud Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, and Migration teams to ensure reliable and secure network connectivity across Sapiens’ infrastructure.

Position Success
•  Network uptime and availability are consistently maintained across cloud and hybrid environments.
•  Secure and reliable multi-region connectivity is implemented and maintained.
•  Network configurations are standardized, documented, and version-controlled.
•  Connectivity provisioning activities are completed within agreed timelines.
•  Network incidents and recurring connectivity issues are reduced, with improved resolution times.
•  Network resilience, security-zone implementation, and configuration consistency are strengthened across multiple environments.

jobAdDetails.title: DevOps Engineer Apps and Agents
jobAdDetails.description:
Job Essence
Platform Engineering is Sapiens' delivery-enablement discipline — the job responsible for building, automating, and continuously operating the CI/CD pipelines, environment provisioning tooling, and Internal Developer Platform (IDP) self-service components that let product engineering squads ship software continuously, safely, and without operational friction. The role treats the platform itself as a product with internal customers whose experience is continuously measured and improved, and that same enabling purpose carries directly into leading the pool responsible for that machinery — coordinating delivery priorities, developing the engineers who build and operate it, and setting the reliability discipline, IDP roadmap, and capability direction that keep Sapiens' SaaS release model dependable as the organisation scales. Whether expressed as direct platform craft or as team leadership and capability stewardship, the purpose stays the same: make continuous, reliable software delivery possible for the whole engineering organisation.

Inclusion Rationale
Platform Engineering exists as a single job because its core purpose — making continuous, reliable software delivery possible for the whole engineering organisation — never changes; only the scope of ownership and the weight of leadership expressed against it grows, from hands-on pipeline ownership through reliability-standard, team, and capability-direction ownership. Consistent with the organisation's preference for one connected capability ladder over separate manager and expert tracks, delivery-enablement work is best governed as a single job so that career progression, compensation, and accountability for platform reliability and team leadership all track the same underlying motion rather than splitting across parallel job codes. Separating the platform's design-authority work into a dedicated architecture job protects the distinct, longer-horizon technical-standards mandate that this broader operating and leadership role does not carry.

Outcomes
  • Self-Service Delivery Enablement
  • Platform Reliability & Error-Budget Discipline
  • Internal Developer Platform Maturity
  • Platform Team & Capability Leadership
jobAdDetails.requirements:
Core technical requirements
  • Strong depth in CI/CD pipeline infrastructure and deployment automation, including rollback.
  • Hands-on experience building Internal Developer Platform (IDP) self-service components, such as environment provisioning and deployment.
  • Experience with container orchestration.
  • Observability configuration: monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, log aggregation and distributed tracing.
  • Automate cloud environments with infrastructure as code so that they are repeatable, consistent, and easier to operate.
  • Design and improve cloud-native CI/CD pipeline templates that give application teams consistent and reliable delivery by default..
Platform-as-a-product and reliability
  • Treats the platform as a product with internal customers and improves IDP adoption and deployment reliability.
  • Defines reusable platform patterns that standardize how multiple squads build, deploy and observe software.
  • Knows reliability standards, SLOs and error budgets for a SaaS release model. 
  • Operate and improve the enterprise secrets management platform, including access policies, credential rotation, application integration, and self-service features.
  • Manage the artifact repository platform so that software dependencies are governed, traceable, and checked for risk
AI-Enabled Engineering
  • Use AI to improve how the platform is built and      run, such as automating routine operational tasks, analysing pipeline      failures, and triaging security findings, with appropriate controls in      place.
  • Apply AI coding assistants and agents to      accelerate the development of infrastructure as code, pipelines, and      automation, and review generated code for quality and security before      release.
  • Deliver platform capabilities that allow      application teams to run AI workloads securely, including access to large      language model APIs, model hosting, and AI agent tooling such as MCP      servers
 
Problem solving
  • Solves ambiguous, cross-team delivery problems, such as redesigning release configurations or provisioning flows to cut recurring failures and toil.
  • Builds durable automation that other platform engineers adopt, rather than fixing each recurrence personally.
Influence and collaboration
  • Influences software engineers and adjacent engineering leads to adopt common patterns over local workarounds.
  • Works with Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability and Platform Architecture.
  • Provides hands-on technical coaching and code review discipline and guides day-to-day work of other contributors on shared components.
Impact and ownership
  • Owns a significant platform workstream, for example self-service deployment architecture, environment automation standards or observability-first delivery instrumentation.
  • Has a track record of higher pipeline success rates and fewer platform-layer incidents.
  • Has driven practices adopted across multiple squads.
  • Accountable for reliability across releases, with local governance over how changes are introduced.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
• Build, automate, and operate the CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and Internal Developer Platform (IDP) self-service components that let product engineering squads provision environments, deploy, and roll back software without requiring individual support.
  • Design and maintain the observability infrastructure for the delivery layer — monitoring dashboards, alerting rules, log aggregation, and distributed tracing — giving the organisation the visibility needed to detect and resolve platform issues before they affect engineering velocity.
  • Own the delivery commitments, reliability standards, and error-budget governance for the SaaS release model — setting SLO thresholds, arbitrating trade-offs between release velocity and platform stability, and reporting platform health transparently to engineering leadership.
  • Coordinate with Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability, and Platform Architecture to align delivery-automation standards, resolve cross-team dependencies, and keep the boundary between operating the platform and designing it clean.
  • Lead the platform engineering pool's day-to-day delivery and on-call execution — sequencing priorities across roadmap and incident load, conducting structured feedback and growth planning, and coaching engineers toward greater technical and leadership depth as the sub-family's scope grows.
  • Set the Platform Engineering capability strategy and workforce direction — determining the skills mix, tooling investment, and operating model needed to keep continuous delivery dependable, and making the hiring and resourcing decisions that keep the pool aligned to the organisation's scaling delivery needs.

jobAdDetails.title: Lead Observability Engineer
jobAdDetails.description:
Sapiens is on the lookout for a Lead Observability Engineer/ APM Engineer to become a key player in our Bangalore team, as we continue to scale observability across a large, multi-customer managed service environment. If you're an expert in Datadog APM who thrives inside traces, service maps, and flame graphs — and is equally comfortable in design forums shaping enterprise monitoring strategy — this role could be the perfect fit, offering high autonomy, deep technical ownership, and a seat at the table in defining how every application we support gets observed, understood, and kept healthy.
About us:Sapiens International Corporation N.V. is a global leader in intelligent, SaaS-based software solutions. With Sapiens’ robust platform, customer-driven partnerships, and rich ecosystem, insurers are empowered to future-proof their organizations with operational excellence in a rapidly changing marketplace.
Our solutions help insurers harness the power of AI and advanced automation to support core solutions for property and casualty, workers’ compensation, and life insurance, including reinsurance, financial & compliance, data & analytics, digital, and decision management.
Sapiens boasts a longtime global presence, serving over 600 customers in more than 30 countries with our innovative offerings. Recognized by industry experts and selected for the Microsoft Top 100 Partner program, Sapiens is committed to partnering with our customers for their entire transformation journey and is continuously innovating to ensure their success.
What you’ll do:
We are looking for an expert Datadog observability engineer whose primary depth is in Application Performance Monitoring. You will own the APM practice across a large, multi-customer managed service environment — defining the architecture, instrumenting applications, leading deep-dive performance investigations, and setting the standards that every application follows when it is onboarded.
This is a hands-on technical role. You will spend your time inside traces, service maps and flame graphs, and equally in design forums and steering committees where APM strategy, coverage and cost are decided. Alongside expert APM skills, we expect strong all-round Datadog observability capability spanning infrastructure, logs, database monitoring, network, Kubernetes, RUM, synthetics, ServiceNow integration and incident management.
Purpose of the Role
  • Improve service reliability and customer experience across all supported applications.
  • Reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve through trace-led root cause analysis.
  • Raise alert quality by replacing symptom-based alerting with dependency-aware, service-level detection.
  • Establish enterprise APM standards that make onboarding repeatable, governed and cost-aware.
Key Responsibilities — Datadog APMAPM Architecture and Implementation
  • Design and implement Datadog APM across enterprise applications and microservices.
  • Lead APM onboarding for new and existing applications, end to end.
  • Define the APM architecture, instrumentation standards and deployment patterns.
  • Configure Datadog Agents and APM components across all application environments.
Distributed Tracing
  • Implement and troubleshoot distributed tracing across multi-tier applications.
  • Trace end-to-end transactions across microservices and APIs, including asynchronous paths.
  • Pinpoint performance bottlenecks along the request path.
  • Analyse trace latency, errors, throughput and resource utilisation.
  • Use trace analytics to detect performance degradation and transaction bottlenecks early.
Application Performance TroubleshootingPerform deep-dive analysis of application performance issues using Datadog APM, covering:
  • Response time, latency and throughput.
  • Error rates, error tracking and request volume.
  • Service dependencies, database calls and external API calls.
  • Resource consumption at process, container and host level.
  • Correlate APM traces with infrastructure metrics and logs.
  • Support complex production incidents and major incident investigations as a senior escalation point.
APM InstrumentationHands-on experience instrumenting applications with Datadog APM across enterprise technologies, including:
  • Java
  • .NET and C#
  • Node.js
  • Python
  • Other enterprise application technologies and runtimes
Practical experience with common frameworks, application servers and microservices architectures is highly desirable, as is familiarity with automatic versus manual instrumentation, custom spans and library-level configuration.
APM Configuration and Optimisation
  • Configure appropriate trace collection and sampling strategies per service and environment.
  • Configure error tracking and analytics.
  • Optimise APM telemetry volume and cost by tuning sampling and removing unnecessary trace collection, without losing diagnostic value.
Database and APM Correlation
  • Correlate application traces with database activity using Datadog Database Monitoring.
  • Identify slow SQL and database calls that contribute to application latency.
  • Analyse database query performance from the application perspective.
  • Troubleshoot connection pool exhaustion and database dependency issues.
  • Work closely with DBA teams across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL and other database platforms.
Service Mapping and Dependencies
  • Build application dependency maps using Datadog APM and Universal Service Monitoring.
  • Identify upstream and downstream dependencies and critical transaction paths.
  • Establish and maintain service ownership through the Datadog Service Catalogue.
  • Support service-level observability and application health monitoring.
APM on Kubernetes and Cloud Platforms
  • Implement and support APM for applications running on Azure, AWS and Kubernetes / AKS.
  • Correlate Kubernetes and container metrics with application traces.
  • Isolate whether a performance issue originates in the application, the container, the Kubernetes node, the database, the network or an external dependency.
APM and ServiceNow Integration
  • Integrate Datadog APM events with ServiceNow ITOM and Event Management.
  • Define how APM events are converted into actionable events and incidents.
  • Ensure appropriate event aggregation, deduplication and suppression during maintenance windows.
  • Support CI and service mapping between Datadog and the ServiceNow CMDB.
  • Ensure APM-driven incidents are routed to the correct resolver groups.
APM Dashboards and Service Level Objectives
  • Develop application-level dashboards covering availability, latency, error rate, throughput, dependency health and database performance, that answer: is the service healthy, what changed, what is the impact, where is the bottleneck, and what should the operator do next.
  • Define application health indicators and establish SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for critical services.
APM Governance and Standards
  • Establish enterprise APM standards and onboarding templates.
  • Define tagging, naming and ownership conventions across the estate.
  • Define monitoring requirements based on application architecture and business criticality.
  • Review APM coverage regularly and identify gaps.
  • Define and drive the APM maturity roadmap.
Broader Datadog Observability ResponsibilitiesAlongside APM depth, the role requires solid breadth across the Datadog platform and the wider observability discipline.
  • Platform breadth — infrastructure monitoring, log management, database monitoring, network performance monitoring, Kubernetes monitoring, Universal Service Monitoring, RUM, synthetic tests, continuous profiler, error tracking and Service Catalogue.
  • Monitoring design — monitor services rather than individual resources, covering availability, performance, capacity, errors, security, dependencies, user experience and recovery. CPU, memory and disk alone are not monitoring.
  • Alert engineering — actionable alerts only, dynamic thresholds where appropriate, composite and dependency-aware monitors, correlation before escalation, deduplication, maintenance suppression and auto-remediation where feasible.
  • Incident correlation — topology-aware event correlation, alert grouping, noise reduction and major incident detection; consolidate multiple symptom alerts into a single actionable incident.
  • Automation — Datadog Workflow Automation, incident enrichment, runbook automation, alert routing and ticket automation.
  • Integrations — Azure Monitor, SolarWinds, ServiceNow, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Event Hub, Event Grid, Microsoft Sentinel, Logic Apps and Azure Functions, with Datadog as the central observability platform.
  • Governance — standard monitoring templates, dashboard standards, ownership models, monitoring lifecycle and consistent customer onboarding across a multi-customer estate.
Essential Skills and Experience
  • Extensive hands-on Datadog experience gained in IT operations, application support or platform engineering.
  • Expert-level Datadog APM capability, including instrumentation, distributed tracing, sampling strategies and trace analytics.
  • Demonstrable experience instrumenting production applications in at least three of Java, .NET / C#, Node.js and Python.
  • Strong working knowledge of microservices, containers, Kubernetes / AKS and cloud-native application architectures.
  • Practical experience correlating application traces with database performance across SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.
  • Proven track record of leading root cause analysis on complex production and major incidents.
  • Experience defining SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for business-critical services.
  • Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ServiceNow ITOM / Event Management.
  • Experience working in a large enterprise or managed service environment supporting multiple customers.
  • Sound understanding of observability cost management and telemetry optimisation.
Desirable Skills and Experience
  • Experience with Datadog Cloud Security, Cloud SIEM, Incident Management, Notebooks and Bits AI.
  • Centralised logging experience with platforms such as Elastic / ELK, Splunk, Grafana Loki or Azure Log Analytics, including log shipping, parsing and retention design.
  • Practical log analysis skills — building structured log pipelines, correlating logs with traces and metrics, and tuning log volume and indexing for cost.
  • Experience migrating from or coexisting with other APM tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic or Elastic APM.
  • Working knowledge of OpenTelemetry and its interoperability with Datadog.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, PowerShell, Go or Terraform, and experience with infrastructure as code for monitoring configuration.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and embedding observability into the delivery lifecycle.
  • Exposure to AIOps practices, anomaly detection and event correlation at scale.
  • Insurance, financial services or other regulated industry experience.
CompetencyThis role carries influence well beyond the tooling. We are looking for the following additional skills and attributes.
  • Problem solving — structured, evidence-led analysis under pressure; comfortable working from an ambiguous symptom to a proven root cause, and honest about what the data does and does not show.
  • Communication — explains complex performance behaviour clearly to engineers, application owners and executives; writes concise incident narratives and RCA documents that stand up to customer scrutiny.
  • Stakeholder management — builds credibility with application teams, DBAs, cloud engineers, service delivery managers and customers across distributed, multi-vendor teams; negotiates standards rather than imposing them.
  • Ownership and accountability — takes end-to-end responsibility for APM coverage and quality, and follows issues through to preventive action.
  • Continuous improvement — actively looks for opportunities to extend coverage, increase automation and cut manual effort, and measures the result.
  • Executive readiness — presents observability posture, risks, quick wins and roadmap in a form suitable for steering committee discussion.
Certifications
  • Essential — Datadog certification, including at least one specialist certification relevant to APM.
  • Desirable — cloud certification such as Microsoft Azure Administrator / Solutions Architect or AWS Solutions Architect.
  • Desirable — Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent container platform certification.
  • Desirable — ITIL Foundation v4, and familiarity with SRE practices and frameworks.
  • Desirable — ServiceNow ITOM or Event Management accreditation.

jobAdDetails.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Specialist
jobAdDetails.description:
Job Essence
Platform Engineering is Sapiens' delivery-enablement discipline — the job responsible for building, automating, and continuously operating the CI/CD pipelines, environment provisioning tooling, and Internal Developer Platform (IDP) self-service components that let product engineering squads ship software continuously, safely, and without operational friction. The role treats the platform itself as a product with internal customers whose experience is continuously measured and improved, and that same enabling purpose carries directly into leading the pool responsible for that machinery — coordinating delivery priorities, developing the engineers who build and operate it, and setting the reliability discipline, IDP roadmap, and capability direction that keep Sapiens' SaaS release model dependable as the organisation scales. Whether expressed as direct platform craft or as team leadership and capability stewardship, the purpose stays the same: make continuous, reliable software delivery possible for the whole engineering organisation.

Inclusion Rationale
Platform Engineering exists as a single job because its core purpose — making continuous, reliable software delivery possible for the whole engineering organisation — never changes; only the scope of ownership and the weight of leadership expressed against it grows, from hands-on pipeline ownership through reliability-standard, team, and capability-direction ownership. Consistent with the organisation's preference for one connected capability ladder over separate manager and expert tracks, delivery-enablement work is best governed as a single job so that career progression, compensation, and accountability for platform reliability and team leadership all track the same underlying motion rather than splitting across parallel job codes. Separating the platform's design-authority work into a dedicated architecture job protects the distinct, longer-horizon technical-standards mandate that this broader operating and leadership role does not carry.

Outcomes
  • Self-Service Delivery Enablement
  • Platform Reliability & Error-Budget Discipline
  • Internal Developer Platform Maturity
  • Platform Team & Capability Leadership

jobAdDetails.title: Associate Developer
jobAdDetails.description:
Start your career where innovation meets real impact.
Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. From day one, you'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experts across the business, build practical AI skills, and develop the capabilities needed to thrive in a global technology company.

Role summary
The Software Engineer is the primary feature builder across Sapiens' software estate — the practitioner who translates product and business requirements into cloud-hosted, production-ready software spanning the client-facing insurance policy, claims, and billing platform as well as the internal business applications that support the organisation's own operations. The role progresses from executing well-defined features within a squad under technical guidance toward technically autonomous contribution that shapes the design of complex systems, mentors peers, and drives engineering quality across the full delivery lifecycle. The role remains the single largest population in the Development family and the foundation of Sapiens' software output capacity. Under Sapiens AI Accelerate, the entry-level role is designed for AI-native developers: graduates who use AI-assisted development as part of their daily work and who, working with Sapiens AIP, help take the SRM platform to its next level.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
•  BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
•  Early-career graduate with up to 18 months of experience.
•  Genuine curiosity about AI, with hands-on experience of AI tools (such as coding assistants or LLMs) in studies, personal projects or internships.
•  Motivated to grow with the SRM platform and help move it forward using Sapiens AIP and modern, AI-assisted engineering.
•  Programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OOP.
•  Proficiency in at least one modern language.
•  Hands-on experience building a working application, service or API (backend or frontend) in a study, personal or internship project.
•  Practical experience using AI tools (such as coding assistants or LLMs) in development, with the judgement to review and verify what they produce.
•  Basic SQL or database knowledge.
•  Exposure to building with AI — for example prompt engineering, simple LLM-based or agent solutions, or calling AI APIs — in a study or personal project.
•  Interest in insurance, or in the policy, claims and billing domain.
•  Familiarity with Git, code review and agile teamwork.
•  Eagerness to learn quickly — including new AI tools and ways of working — and take guidance.
•  Builder mindset and ownership: looks for small, practical improvements to code, tests and build steps, including by using AI.
•  Collaboration with experts across the business.
•  Fluent English.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
•  Design, code, test, and deploy application features — backend services, APIs, frontend components, or integration layers — for both the client-facing insurance platform and internal business applications, working within an agile delivery squad and applying cloud-native development patterns as the default approach.
•  Participate in technical design sessions to define system components, data flows, and API contracts for new features, contributing at a depth proportionate to seniority — from implementation-focused input at earlier levels through to architectural influence at higher scope.
•  Integrate security controls into the development lifecycle by applying threat modelling principles, addressing SAST and DAST scan findings, and following security-by-design standards to ensure every feature shipped meets the platform's security baseline.
•  Build and maintain CI/CD pipeline configurations, release scripts, and build automation tooling as a native extension of the development process — ensuring code moves from commit to deployment with speed, integrity, and traceability.
•  Write and maintain automated unit, integration, and component tests as part of the definition of done for every feature, contributing to the automated test coverage that the Quality Engineering sub-family governs at the pipeline level.
•  Use AI-assisted development tools and Sapiens AIP in day-to-day work — for example to draft and review code, tests and documentation, and to help build AI-enabled capabilities on top of the SRM platform — while validating every AI output for correctness, security and quality before it is committed.

jobAdDetails.title: AI Engineer
jobAdDetails.description:
Start your career where innovation meets real impact.
Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. From day one, you'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experts across the business, build practical AI skills, and develop the capabilities needed to thrive in a global technology company.

The role
Agentic Data Foundation is the action layer. AI agents reason over governed data products and ML insight, not raw tables. We expose data and ML as governed MCP tools, build Synapse (our insurance ontology and semantic knowledge layer) and context as a service. Our agents are read-only, bound to one customer, fully logged and approved by people. This is a building role on a greenfield platform, with short prototype cycles and direct impact on product direction.

Our stack: Python for agentic workloads, MCP, LLMs (Azure OpenAI), GraphQL APIs, Azure Databricks and Unity Catalog, ontology standards (SKOS, OWL, RDF and W3C).
jobAdDetails.requirements:
You should have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/Data Science or similar; 0–18 months of experience (internships and projects count).
  • Python, plus hands-on LLM projects: prompting, structured output, function/tool calling and handling failures.
  • SQL and API basics (REST or GraphQL); Git.
  • AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in your daily workflow.
  • Self-directed: comfortable with ambiguity, you make decisions and you ship.
Even better if you have
  • LangChain/LangGraph or similar; MCP or other agent standards.
  • Embeddings, vector databases and RAG in a real application; building evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs.
  • Knowledge graphs or ontologies (RDF, OWL, SPARQL); TypeScript.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
What you will do
  • Build MCP tools. Expose governed data and ML outputs as typed, policy-checked, read-only tools for agents.
  • Prototype agents. Build multi-step, tool-using agent workflows for insurance cases such as claims triage and lapse risk.
  • Evaluate and secure. Write evaluation harnesses for reliability, plus guardrail tests (tenant isolation, free text treated as data, every call logged).
  • Add meaning. Help build ontology, knowledge-graph and context-service components with the Synapse team.
  • Ship and explain. Use AI coding tools daily, document and demo every prototype.
jobAdDetails.benefits:
Why join
You will design agent architectures on governed enterprise data, solve reliability and evaluation problems, and see your work in front of insurers. Fast path to AI engineer or agent architect.

jobAdDetails.title: Database Administrator (MSSQL)
jobAdDetails.description:
We are looking for a mid SQL Server DBA to join our Global Cloud DBA team in Portugal. You will own the day-to-day operation, availability and performance of MSSQL estates hosted on Azure and AWS for GDPR, EMEA and US customers, working a fixed shift aligned to EMEA business hours with rotational on-call responsibility for critical incidents outside those hours. You will also build working capability on Oracle, PostgreSQL and MySQL as secondary platforms to widen cross-platform coverage.

Location: Portugal, Lisbon
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• 6–10 years of hands-on database administration experience, with a majority on Microsoft SQL Server in production environments.
  • Demonstrable experience supporting enterprise or managed-services customers under formal SLAs.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent practical experience.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300), Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or AWS Certified Database — Specialty are an advantage.
  • Eligibility to work in Portugal.
  • Proven track record working for a Born-in-the-Cloud or Cloud-Native technology company — must have.

Professional skills
  • Strong written and spoken English; able to communicate directly with customer stakeholders.
  • Structured troubleshooting under production pressure, with clear escalation and hand-over discipline across shifts.
  • Ownership mindset — validating changes before they reach production and owning the rollback path.
  • Willingness to cross-skill into the secondary database platforms; the team actively runs MSSQL ↔ Oracle cross-training to widen coverage across the on-call rotation.
  • Documentation habit — runbooks, knowledge-base articles and post-incident notes.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
• 24×7 production support for MSSQL estates across EMEA, GDPR and US customers — incident response, root-cause analysis and SLA-bound resolution of P1/P2 issues.
  • Execution and validation of customer scripts and datafixes against production and pre-production databases, including impact assessment, backup/snapshot before execution and ownership of the rollback path.
  • Backup, restore and recovery operations; periodic recovery testing and RTO/RPO validation.
  • Database refresh, clone and copy activities across environments, including masked refreshes for non-production.
  • High availability and disaster recovery: configuration, monitoring, failover testing and recovery.
  • Performance monitoring and tuning — query and index optimisation, blocking and contention analysis, capacity and growth management.
  • Planned change delivery: pre-implementation backups, implementation, post-implementation and post-patching validation within agreed maintenance windows.
  • Access and permission management, user provisioning and privilege reviews.
  • Patching, upgrades and migrations, including cloud migrations and version upgrades.
  • Automation of routine operational tasks and contribution to self-healing and monitoring improvements.
  • Proactive analysis of recurring incidents to identify and eliminate root causes rather than repeatedly remediating them.

jobAdDetails.title: Lead Product Manager - Platform
jobAdDetails.description:
Sapiens is a global leader in intelligent SaaS-based software solutions for the insurance industry, serving more than 600 insurers worldwide. We are transforming the insurance landscape through innovative technology, cloud-based platforms and AI-powered solutions that help insurers modernize operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager – Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care & Group to lead the strategic direction, development and commercial success of our US Life and Annuity portfolio, while expanding our capabilities across Long-Term Care (LTC) and Group Insurance.

This is a hands-on leadership position combining product strategy, market development and day-to-day product management. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Delivery, Sales, Marketing and executive leadership to shape the product roadmap, drive innovation and position Sapiens as a leading technology partner for US insurance carriers.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
Required
  • 10+ years of experience within the US Life Insurance, Annuities, Long-Term Care and/or Group Insurance industries.
  • Deep domain expertise in at least two of the following areas: Life Insurance, Annuities, Long-Term Care or Group Insurance.
  • Proven experience in hands-on product management within an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Strong understanding of insurance products and processes, including policy administration, new business, underwriting, servicing, commissions, billing and claims.
  • Experience owning product portfolios and demonstrating measurable business impact through revenue growth, customer retention or competitive win rates.
  • Strong understanding of US insurance regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership, customers and technical teams.

Preferred
  • Experience introducing AI, automation or intelligent capabilities into regulated insurance environments.
  • Exposure to cloud-based SaaS platforms and modernization of legacy insurance administration systems.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and integrations, including ACORD, DTCC, enrollment and billing feeds, and employer or benefits administration platforms.
  • Background in actuarial, underwriting or insurance operations.
  • Professional designations such as FLMI, LOMA or equivalent industry credentials.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager or Business Analyst supporting insurance platform implementations.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap across Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care and Group Insurance.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging industry trends and customer requirements to guide product investment and innovation.
  • Develop business cases and prioritize product initiatives based on commercial value, customer needs, regulatory requirements and platform capabilities.
  • Drive the expansion of Sapiens' product offerings into LTC and Group Insurance markets.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to establish investment priorities and support overall portfolio growth.

Product Development & Execution
  • Lead hands-on product management activities within an Agile development environment.
  • Own and prioritize product backlogs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirements.
  • Partner with Engineering, Domain Modelers and Solution Designers to translate business needs into scalable product solutions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and product acceptance.
  • Prepare product documentation, smartbooks and functional specifications.
  • Work directly with Sapiens' CoreSuite platform, including product configuration, demonstrations and evaluation of platform capabilities.
  • Drive AI-enabled product innovation, leveraging automation and intelligent capabilities across underwriting, new business, policy administration, claims and servicing.

Market & Customer Engagement
  • Develop a deep understanding of the US Life, Annuity, LTC and Group Insurance markets, including customer needs, competitive positioning and emerging product trends.
  • Build strong relationships with insurance carriers, distributors, brokers and strategic partners.
  • Lead customer advisory discussions and engage with executive stakeholders to understand business priorities.
  • Translate customer feedback and market insights into actionable product enhancements and roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities, customer presentations, product demonstrations and RFP responses.

Regulatory & Industry Expertise
  • Monitor US insurance regulatory developments and ensure product capabilities remain aligned with applicable industry requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of relevant NAIC regulations, state insurance requirements, annuity suitability standards and life insurance product regulations.
  • Understand regulatory considerations impacting LTC, including rate increases, claims handling and state partnership programs.
  • Support Group Insurance requirements, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, portability and conversion.
  • Ensure regulatory changes are incorporated into product roadmaps and delivered effectively to customers.

Commercial & Business Leadership
  • Drive portfolio growth through new customer acquisition, existing customer expansion and improved competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop product positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategies.
  • Support pricing, packaging and commercial decisions in partnership with product and commercial leadership.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption, customer satisfaction and revenue contribution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, product quality and overall cost to serve.
jobAdDetails.benefits:
At Sapiens, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of insurance technology and contribute to the evolution of AI-powered, intelligent insurance platforms.
You'll work alongside talented professionals across Product, Engineering, Delivery and Commercial teams, with the opportunity to influence strategic product decisions, drive innovation and make a meaningful impact across the North American insurance market.

We offer an environment that values collaboration, professional development, innovation and continuous improvement.

Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background and evaluate everyone on merit.

The Procurement Operations Manager is the operational backbone of the Sapiens procurement function. This role owns the day-to-day running of the buyer team — workload management, SLA compliance, process governance, and systems performance — ensuring that every purchase request moves through the right workflow, at pace, and to the right standard.
Reporting directly to the Procurement Manager, you will manage a team of category buyers and a procurement analyst, serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues, and drive the team’s readiness for Dynamics 365 and AI-assisted automation. This is a high-ownership role for a senior procurement professional who thrives on structure, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Team Management & Operations
  • Day-to-day management of all buyers and the procurement analyst: workload distribution, capacity planning, and SLA performance.
  • Buyer performance management, onboarding, and operational coaching across all spend categories.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for urgent purchase requests, vendor disputes, and operational exceptions.
  • Ensure adequate coverage across categories; manage interim capacity during open headcount periods.
 
Process Governance & Systems
  • Own PRS and ServiceNow workflow configuration: approval routing, queue management, and policy compliance.
  • Define and enforce one consistent procurement process across all buyers, categories, and workflows.
  • Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, escalation paths, and buyer playbooks.
  • Ensure team adherence to internal procurement policies and audit requirements.
 
Dynamics 365 & Automation Readiness
  • Lead the team’s operational readiness for the Dynamics 365 ERP migration — workflow mapping, category taxonomy alignment, and training.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities within buyer workflows, in collaboration with the Technology BP and Procurement Manager.
  • Champion AI-assisted tools and process improvements to increase team efficiency and data quality.
 
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Finance on PO reconciliation, budget compliance, and month-end close support.
  • Coordinate with the Procurement Manager – Technology BP on technology buyer capacity, priorities, and workload alignment.
  • Support the Procurement Manager on team structure, hiring, and performance reviews.
  • Provide operational data, KPI dashboards, and savings tracking to support strategic reporting.
 
REQUIREMENTS
Must Have
  • 10+ years in procurement operations, purchasing, or supply chain management within a technology or enterprise software company.
  • Proven experience managing a buyer team: workload distribution, SLA ownership, and performance management.
  • Strong command of P2P systems — ServiceNow, SAP, or equivalent ERP/procurement platforms.
  • Process governance mindset: experience defining and enforcing procurement policies across a multi-buyer team.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operational escalations in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong communication skills; comfortable working across Finance, IT, R&D, and senior stakeholders.
  • Fluent English.
 
Preferred
  • Experience leading or contributing to an ERP migration (Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to procurement workflows (contract review, spend analytics, RFP drafting).
  • Exposure to Software Asset Management or technology procurement operations.
  • CIPS or equivalent procurement qualification.

jobAdDetails.title: Pricing Operations Analyst
jobAdDetails.description:
Sapiens UK is seeking a Pricing Operations Analyst to support our Pricing Operations team in London, as part of a new requisition approved to keep pace with growing demand across the business.
 
Working Model: Hybrid (Flexible) London
 
This is an execution-focused pricing operations role. Working alongside the Pricing Operations team and reporting to the Manager, Pricing Operations, you will manage pricing requests through the governance process end to end, helping the wider team manage peak volume and keep turnaround times on track.
 
The role suits someone early in their pricing, pricing operations, deal desk, or commercial operations career who is organised, accurate under pace, and keen to build a foundation in enterprise B2B pricing.
 
The role works cross-functionally with Deal Desk, Sales Operations, and divisional commercial teams across Property & Casualty, Life & Pension, Reinsurance, and the AI platform business.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
The ideal candidate will be building a career in pricing or commercial operations, rather than an established specialist.
  • Experience – one to three years in pricing, deal desk, sales operations, revenue operations, pricing operations, or commercial support, ideally within B2B software. Strong candidates with relevant experience in adjacent commercial or finance operations roles are also welcome.
  • Accuracy under pace – comfortable working through a queue of requests to deadline, without letting volume compromise accuracy.
  • Tooling – working knowledge of Excel; exposure to Salesforce or CPQ tools is an advantage but not required, as training will be provided.
  • Communication – able to escalate clearly and work collaboratively with a small, busy team.
  • Technical skills – SQL is not required for this role. Comfort learning new systems and AI-enabled tooling such as Claude Cowork is an advantage.
 
Relevant Experience
We welcome candidates from:
  • Deal desk, sales operations, pricing support, or pricing operations roles in B2B software or professional services.
  • Graduate or early-career commercial, finance, or business operations backgrounds looking to specialise in pricing.
  • Customer operations or order management roles with strong process discipline and Excel skills.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Key Workstreams
  • Processing of individual pricing requests through the governance workflow, covering intake, calculation, and approval routing.
  • Support for the Pricing Operations team during periods of high deal volume, picking up overflow requests to keep queues within SLA.
  • Accurate entry and upkeep of deal records in CPQ and Salesforce, so pricing data stays current and traceable.
  • Escalation of non-standard or complex deals to the Manager, Pricing Operations or the relevant Pricing Operations Analyst.
  • Input into pricing reporting packs, pulling and checking deal-level data used in wider commercial reporting.
  • Turn around individual pricing requests accurately and within agreed SLAs, using the approved pricing models and calculators.
  • Apply the pricing governance process consistently on each request, flagging exceptions rather than resolving them independently.
  • Work flexibly across a queue of pricing requests, prioritising by deadline and business impact in coordination with the wider Pricing Operations team.
  • Keep deal and pricing records clean and current in CPQ and Salesforce.
  • Support the Pricing Operations team and Manager with data pulls, checks, and administrative tasks tied to the pricing pipeline.
  • Flag process friction or recurring errors to the Manager, Pricing Operations to support continuous improvement.

jobAdDetails.title: Revenue Manager
jobAdDetails.description:
The Revenue Manager is the organisation's technical authority on when and how revenue is recognised. That role matters even more as the business shifts to SaaS. You will apply ASC 606 to an evolving portfolio of multi-element contracts, combining SaaS licences, implementation services, professional services and usage-based AI consumption fees. You will make sure revenue recognition is correct, consistently applied and free of restatement risk. You will also be the pre-signature accounting checkpoint for non-standard commercial contracts.
This is a hands-on role with a leadership mandate. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will build the revenue accounting team and grow it as the function scales.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• 8–10 years of experience in revenue accounting, including experience in a Revenue Controller or equivalent senior technical role.
  • Experience leading, mentoring or managing accountants, or a clear readiness to build and lead a team.
  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606 / US GAAP.
  • Experience with multi-element arrangements, standalone selling price analysis and complex contract structures.
  • Comfortable operating as a pre-signature technical checkpoint, partnering with Deal Desk, Sales and Legal.
  • Experience managing external audit relationships and SOX (or equivalent) controls for revenue processes.
  • Familiarity with ERP-native or specialist revenue recognition platforms, and an interest in automating manual close activities.
  • AI proficiency: able to apply AI tools across large data sets, automation and contract review.
  • Strong ability to read and analyse commercial agreements and identify revenue recognition implications in non-standard terms.
  • Strong communication skills, including explaining technical accounting positions to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Advantage: prior experience in a professional department (audit) at an accounting firm.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Team Building and Leadership
  • Build the revenue accounting team: define roles and hiring needs, recruit, onboard and develop talent.
  • Coach and mentor team members, set goals and review work for accuracy and consistency as the team grows.
  • Establish ways of working, including AI-enabled approaches, as the business model evolves.
Revenue Recognition and Technical Accounting
  • Apply ASC 606 to the organisation's contract portfolio, performing multi-element arrangement analysis, identifying and allocating standalone selling prices, and determining the timing and amount of revenue recognition for each performance obligation.
  • Monitor the evolving portfolio of subscription, AI consumption and professional services arrangements, and proactively identify contract structures or business model changes that create new technical accounting questions.
  • Develop, maintain and communicate revenue recognition policies and procedures across finance and commercial functions, ensuring consistent application through the SaaS transition.
Revenue Close and Reporting
  • Own and execute the revenue month-end close: revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue reconciliations, revenue journal entries and the revenue management report for financial management review. Delegate and review as the team grows.
  • Identify and lead opportunities to automate recurring revenue recognition calculations and schedules through ERP-native functionality or specialist revenue recognition platforms.
Deal Desk and Pre-Signature Review
  • Review non-standard commercial contracts submitted through the Deal Desk approval workflow, assessing revenue recognition implications and providing written guidance before contract execution.
  • Serve as the accounting checkpoint in the commercial approval process for non-standard deal structures.
Controls and Audit
  • Manage the relationship with external auditors on revenue recognition matters, preparing technical accounting memos, providing audit support workpapers and resolving revenue accounting queries during audit cycles.
  • Administer SOX (or equivalent) internal controls for the revenue recognition process, ensuring controls are designed, documented and operating effectively.

jobAdDetails.title: Customer Success Director
jobAdDetails.description:
We are building a new Customer Success team and are hiring a Customer Success Director to look after a portfolio of our commercial insurance customers through a consistent, playbook-led motion. You will be the named contact for a larger book of accounts, accountable for keeping them healthy and renewable at scale. This is a one-to-few role for people who run a disciplined, repeatable Customer Success motion and work with customers' operational owners day to day, rather than at C-suite level.
 
Working model & location: Hybrid (Flexible), Riga
 
About Sapiens
Sapiens International is a global provider of core software for the insurance industry, serving Property & Casualty, Life & Pensions, and Reinsurance carriers worldwide. Our Customer Success team keeps and grows our customers beyond go-live.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• 5+ years in a customer-facing role (Customer Success, account management, consulting, or customer support) managing a portfolio of accounts, including relationship management and issue resolution.
  • Insurance domain experience (P&C, Life & Pensions, or Reinsurance), or enterprise software serving insurers.
  • A track record of building Customer Success plans and delivering measurable retention and account-health outcomes (e.g. gross retention, NPS).
  • Experience running a consistent, playbook-led Customer Success motion across many accounts at once.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and challenge stakeholders.
  • Commercial and business acumen – able to understand and speak to customers' business drivers.
  • Strong prioritisation and reporting skills; able to synthesise and communicate key insights.
  • Able to work autonomously with ownership and accountability, with a design-thinking, root-cause approach to problem-solving.
 
What you will bring (desirable)
  • Familiarity with core insurance platforms (policy administration, claims, or billing).
  • Experience with Customer Success tooling and AI-assisted health monitoring.
  • Experience with cloud-native or SaaS delivery and managed solutions.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
• Deliver Sapiens' Customer Success motion for your book in line with the defined framework, playbooks, and tier coverage model.
  • Be the named Customer Success Manager and maintain strong customer relationships built on credibility, consistency, and value, from go-live onward at a steady cadence.
  • Own account health and product adoption across the book; track and report on adoption, usage, and health metrics, and act early where an account starts to slip.
  • Run a consistent, standardised review cycle and build templated Customer Success plans that connect each customer's business goals to the value they get from Sapiens.
  • Protect the retention floor: identify at-risk accounts early and orchestrate and mediate escalation resolution by pulling in the right internal stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate Sales, Support, Delivery, Product, and Enablement so the customer experiences one coordinated relationship, coordinating training and resources as needed.
  • Identify expansion (cross-sell and upsell) opportunities aligned to the customer's strategy and pass them to Sales to progress. You own the signal, not the sale.
  • Use AI-assisted monitoring and standard health triggers to run a larger book efficiently.
 
Scope
You own the customer's success and growth from point of sale onward. You do not carry a sales quota or close deals, run support tickets, or run implementation projects – Sales, Support, and Delivery own those. You protect retention, flag expansion, and escalate on the customer's behalf.

jobAdDetails.description:

Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. The L2 Support Engineer handles escalated, complex, and technically demanding issues that go beyond L0 scope, including data-related, AI coding, configuration, integration, and -behaviour problems specific to our AIP product. As L3/engineering is not part of this organisation, the L2 role also acts as the technical bridge to the FDE’s. Additionally working with, product/engineering/cloud team when a defect or product limitation is confirmed and owns the resolution process end-to-end from a support perspective.

•           Bachelor of Science (BSc) or Master of Science (MSc) 
•           Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science / Analytics, Software Engineering, AI

Language:
•           Fluent in English

jobAdDetails.title: Lead Quality Assurance Analyst (Bilingual English-French)
jobAdDetails.description:
Location – Canada / Remote
 
Sapiens is seeking a dynamic and experienced Lead Quality Assurance Analyst  (Bilingual English-French) to oversee the quality assurance efforts for a complex, integrated platform comprising multiple modules. This role requires hands-on leadership, strategic planning, and technical expertise in both manual and automation testing. The Lead Quality Assurance Analyst will manage a hybrid QA team, drive platform-wide quality initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and high-quality delivery.
 
Responsibilities
 
Test Strategy & Planning
  • Define and implement comprehensive test strategies for manual and automation testing across modules.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into test artifacts including test cases, automation scripts, and test plans.
  • Plan and estimate QA efforts during sprint planning and release cycles.
  • Ensure alignment with QA best practices, design patterns, and organizational standards.

Test Execution & Platform Oversight
  • Oversee execution of manual and automated test cases across functional, regression, integration, and UAT phases.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows across integrated modules and shared services.
  • Coordinate system-level testing across environments (staging, pre-prod, production).
  • Monitor automation coverage and maintain regression suite health.

Defect & Risk Management
  • Identify, document, and track defects; collaborate with development and BA teams for resolution.
  • Evaluate defect impact across modules and prioritize based on business and technical risk.
  • Proactively identify platform-level quality risks and implement mitigation strategies.

Metrics & Compliance
  • Create and distribute QA reports covering test progress, defect metrics, risk mitigation plans, and platform KPIs.
  • Review and act on quality indicators such as defect leakage, test case effectiveness, and release confidence.
  • Ensure compliance with QA standards, audit requirements, and regulatory guidelines.

Team Leadership & Development
  • Lead and mentor a team of manual and automation QA engineers.
  • Support onboarding, training, and continuous learning for team members.
  • Conduct performance reviews and foster a culture of accountability and excellence.

Collaboration & Communication
  • Act as the primary QA contact for product, development, and delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with SMEs, architects, and module owners to ensure quality deliverables.
  • Facilitate cross-team defect triage and platform-level release readiness meetings.
  • Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement across teams.
 
Technical Skills
  • Experience in life insurance domain (individual life and annuities) – Must
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium frameworks).
  • Knowledge of REST/SOAP API testing and interface validation.
  • Ability to write SQL queries.
  • Familiarity with test management tools (e.g., Jira, Zephyr, QC).

Leadership & Communication
  • Proven experience managing hybrid QA teams and platform-level testing.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience in client-facing roles (e.g., pre-sales, UAT coordination).
  • Ability to work independently and lead by example.

Qualifications
  • Bilingual English French - Must
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (preferred).
  • ISTQB or equivalent certification - Advantage
  • 10+ years of QA experience, with at least 3 years in a lead role.

Added Advantage
  • Experience in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).
  • Exposure to performance, accessibility, and cross-browser testing.
  • Experience in tool evaluation and selection for manual and automation testing.
  • Willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.
