jobAdDetails.title: Associate Accountant
jobAdDetails.description:
Start your career where innovation meets real impact.
Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. From day one, you'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experts across the business, build practical AI skills, and develop the capabilities needed to thrive in a global technology company.

Job Essence
Accounting is the organization's continuous engine of financial truth production — the single accountable lane that carries a transaction from its first entry in the general ledger through to the revenue recognition judgment that determines when and how it is reported. The role maintains the general ledger, reconciliations, and close-supporting schedules that every downstream accounting and statutory process depends on, and it extends that same ledger discipline into the technical application of revenue recognition standards across the organization's evolving contract mix — subscriptions, AI consumption agreements, and professional services. Accounting also serves as the pre-signature checkpoint for commercial contracts, reviewing non-standard revenue structures and providing technical guidance before they are executed. Across the organization's multi-country operational footprint, Accounting converts day-to-day transactional activity and evolving contract complexity alike into the accurate, defensible, and audit-ready financial record that governance, reporting, and compliance functions build upon.

Outcomes
  • Accurate General Ledger
  • Reconciled Account Balances
  • Close-Ready Supporting Schedules
  • Complete Statutory Reporting Inputs
  • Accurate Revenue Recognition
  • Pre-Signature Risk Flagging
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• A graduate with 0-18 months of experience, ready to learn and contribute.
• Education in Accounting (accountant profile).
• High level of English, written and spoken.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Working knowledge of US GAAP.
• Basic accounting knowledge applicable to recurring general ledger transactions, journal
entries, accruals and prepayments.
• Ability to work under established chart-of-accounts and policy guidance, and to meet defined
close-cycle deadlines.
• Attention to detail: able to compare entries with source documents and spot basic posting
errors.
• Sound judgment on when to escalate unfamiliar reconciling items to reviewers before they
affect the close timetable.
• Clear communication and a collaborative approach with finance operations contacts and
internal submitters.
• Ownership: accountable for the completeness and accuracy of assigned entries and
supporting documentation before handoff, with moderate oversight.
• Willingness to build practical AI skills and grow within a global technology company.
Nice to have
• Familiarity with standard receivables procedures (customer invoices, payment application,
aging) for roles with customer ledger scope.
• Interest in revenue recognition across subscription, AI consumption and professional
services contracts.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
• Maintain the general ledger for assigned entities, recording journal entries, accruals, and prepayments in compliance with accounting policy and applicable standards
  • Support the period-end close process — preparing supporting schedules, posting standard and revenue-related journal entries, and delivering trial balance inputs within close timelines
  • Maintain balance sheet, intercompany, and revenue account reconciliations at defined cadences, clearing reconciling items and escalating material discrepancies to Financial Control promptly
  • Prepare and organize the supporting schedules, disclosure inputs, and revenue recognition workpapers required for statutory financial statement preparation, ensuring data is complete and traceable to source
  • Review non-standard commercial contracts submitted through the Deal Desk approval workflow, assessing revenue recognition implications and providing technical guidance before contract execution
  • Maintain audit support workpapers across ledger and revenue recognition areas, keeping financial balances traceable to source documents and control evidence organized for review
  • Monitor day-to-day ledger activity alongside the evolving mix of subscription, consumption, and services arrangements, correcting posting errors and flagging new technical accounting questions before they affect close or reporting deadlines

Title: Sr. Presales Engineer, Cloud
Location: Remote
 
Sapiens is seeking an experienced Sr. Cloud Solutions Engineer to support our North American Go-to-Market (GTM) organization.
 
This is a customer-facing technical and commercial role that works closely with Sales throughout the opportunity lifecycle. The Cloud Solutions Engineer serves as a bridge between the customer, Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Delivery, Finance, Pricing, and other internal teams required to develop a complete solution.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong cloud and SaaS knowledge with commercial awareness, excellent communication skills, and the ability to coordinate complex opportunities across a global organization. This role is part of the Go-to-Market organization and will primarily support North American opportunities while collaborating extensively with global teams.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Sales & Opportunity Support
  • Partner with Sales throughout the opportunity lifecycle as the primary Cloud Solutions Engineering resource for SaaS, Agentic AI and cloud-related discussions.
  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer operational objectives, architecture, security considerations, operational requirements, and cloud strategy.
  • Support complex enterprise opportunities involving multiple Sapiens products, platforms, and technical dependencies.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Sales and customer stakeholders throughout evaluation, proposal, and contracting activities (participating in contract negotiating).
Proposals, Presentations & Deal Support
  • Support RFP, RFI, and other formal proposal processes, including cloud, SaaS, infrastructure, security, and architecture responses.
  • Develop and deliver customer-facing presentations, solution workshops, architecture discussions, and demonstrations of Sapiens cloud and SaaS capabilities.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to audiences ranging from engineers and architects to business leaders and executives.
  • Participate in technical and commercial contract discussions related to SaaS and cloud services.
  • Help identify material deviations from standard SaaS and cloud operating models before contractual commitments are made.
Cloud Solution Design & Technical Discovery
  • Facilitate technical discovery sessions and workshops with customer architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, and executive teams.
  • Explain Sapiens SaaS and cloud capabilities, including infrastructure, environments, networking, security, resiliency, monitoring, disaster recovery, and operational models.
  • Support customers evaluating cloud migration and SaaS transformation strategies.
  • Coordinate with Product, Cloud Engineering, Security, Professional Services, and other subject-matter experts to resolve complex technical requirements.
Commercial & Pricing Support
  • Develop cloud cost models and commercial inputs for new opportunities, expansions, migrations, and contractual changes.
  • Translate technical requirements into infrastructure, services, third-party components, environments, and operational assumptions required to support commercial pricing.
  • Partner with Pricing, Finance, Sales, and other stakeholders to ensure cloud-related assumptions and costs are accurately represented in customer proposals.
  • Support scenario modeling when technical or commercial requirements change.
  • Clearly document assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and factors that may materially affect solution cost or delivery.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  • Work extensively across Sapiens' global organization, including Sales, Product, Cloud Engineering, Security, Professional Services, Finance, Pricing, Legal, and Customer Success.
  • Act as an orchestrator for complex opportunities where inputs from multiple technical and business functions are required.
  • Contribute to improving and standardizing Cloud Solutions Engineering processes, tools, documentation, and reusable solution assets.
  • Maintain current knowledge of cloud architecture, SaaS operating models, cybersecurity, AI, and other technologies relevant to Sapiens solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve speed, consistency, and scalability through standardization, automation, and AI-enabled tooling.
 
 
Skills & Requirements:
  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Cloud Architecture, technical pre-sales, or a related customer-facing technology role.
  • Experience supporting RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and contractual discussions.
  • Strong customer-facing presentation, discovery, workshop facilitation, proposal-writing, and written communication skills.
  • Experience supporting enterprise B2B software, SaaS, or cloud solutions; complex enterprise software experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to coordinate information across a large, distributed organization.
  • Strong understanding of public cloud and SaaS architecture, including infrastructure, networking, security, environments, resiliency, monitoring, and operational considerations.
  • Experience presale solutions on Microsoft Azure or AWS.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into assumptions, dependencies, and commercial inputs.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously and respond effectively in a fast-moving sales environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with financial models, cloud cost models, spreadsheets, and commercial assumptions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both deeply technical audiences and senior business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning, particularly across cloud, SaaS, security, and AI technologies.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting enterprise insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS transformation or cloud migration initiatives.
  • Familiarity with cloud cost management, FinOps, or SaaS unit economics.
  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve technical, analytical, or operational workflows.
  • Experience with Salesforce or other enterprise CRM and sales tooling.
  • Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, or cloud architecture certifications.
Working Style
 
This role is well suited for someone comfortable operating at the intersection of technology and business. The successful candidate will be able to move between detailed technical discussions, commercial analysis, customer presentations, and internal coordination without losing sight of the larger objective: helping the Go-to-Market organization develop solutions that customers understand, Sapiens can deliver, and both parties can confidently commit to.
 
The role is primarily focused on North America but involves regular collaboration with global teams. Some customer and internal travel may be required.
 
 
 
At Sapiens, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment. We believe that diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences make us stronger and more innovative. We are committed to creating a culture where every individual is valued and can thrive regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, or any other characteristic.
 
Sapiens is an E-Verified & Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobAdDetails.title: Senior Performance Engineer
jobAdDetails.description:
Senior Performance Engineer
Sapiens International Corporation (NASDAQ and TASE: SPNS) is a leading global provider of software solutions for the insurance industry, with an emerging focus on the broader financial services sector. We offer core, end-to-end solutions to the global general insurance, property and casualty, life, pension and annuities, and retirement markets, as well as business decision management software. We have a track record of over 30 years in delivering superior software solutions to more than 400 financial services organizations. The Sapiens team of approximately 2,500 professionals operates through our fully owned subsidiaries
DescriptionThe Senior Performance Engineer is responsible for validating the scalability, responsiveness, stability, and resilience of insurance applications through disciplined performance engineering, robust workload design, and deep technical analysis. This role exists to improve release confidence, reduce production risk, and ensure that systems continue to perform reliably under expected, peak, and stress conditions across user journeys, APIs, integrations, and data-intensive processes.
The role requires strong expertise in performance test strategy, scripting, execution, observability, bottleneck diagnosis, and root cause analysis across enterprise platforms. It is suited to a hands-on senior engineer who can translate system architecture and business-critical usage patterns into meaningful performance coverage, identify capacity and stability risks early, and help teams deliver systems with greater efficiency, predictability, and customer confidence.
The Senior Performance Engineer will leverage modern Agile methodologies, observability tooling, CI/CD-aligned practices, and AI-augmented analysis to accelerate performance feedback, strengthen engineering decisions, and deliver high-confidence software to clients.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define and drive performance testing strategy for insurance applications, ensuring meaningful coverage across load, stress, endurance, scalability, and stability scenarios.
  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts and scenarios using approved performance engineering tools and scripting languages.
  • Translate architecture, usage patterns, integrations, batch behaviour, and business-critical transactions into realistic workload models and measurable performance objectives.
  • Analyse application, infrastructure, database, and API behaviour under load to identify bottlenecks, degradation patterns, concurrency risks, and capacity constraints.
  • Perform in-depth root cause analysis of performance issues by correlating test results with logs, traces, database behaviour, and APM insights.
  • Generate clear performance reports, findings, and recommendations that help engineering, product, and delivery teams make informed release and tuning decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, architects, DevOps, product owners, and project teams to improve system efficiency, reliability, and non-functional readiness.
  • Use SQL and database analysis to validate data volumes, transaction behaviour, and performance-impacting patterns across large datasets.
  • Deploy, monitor, and interpret performance telemetry using APM and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Grafana, or equivalent platforms.
  • Contribute to integrating performance testing into the software development lifecycle and release process so that risks are identified earlier and resolved faster.
  • Recommend improvements to application design, configuration, infrastructure usage, and runtime tuning based on observed bottlenecks and evidence.
  • Support continuous improvement of performance engineering practices, tools, reusable assets, baselines, and reporting standards.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers through technical guidance, troubleshooting support, and stronger engineering discipline in performance analysis.
  • Use approved AI/LLM tools to accelerate workload design, scenario expansion, SQL/query drafting, log interpretation, and initial performance hypothesis generation, while validating outputs for correctness and technical fit.
  • Use AI-assisted diagnostics to cluster patterns, surface anomalies faster, and improve turnaround during performance triage and root-cause investigation.
  • Contribute to performance validation in cloud-hosted and SaaS-style environments by assessing environment-specific behaviour, scalability characteristics, release impacts, and multi-tenant or shared-resource considerations where applicable.
Must Have Skills & QualificationsExperience & Background
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in performance engineering or performance testing of enterprise applications.
  • 3+ years of experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, OctoPerf, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with web applications, APIs, multi-tier systems, and enterprise application architectures.
  • Experience in insurance products or insurance technology platforms is preferred; policy, billing, claims, digital, or transaction-heavy platform exposure is valuable.
  • Exposure to Agile or iterative software delivery environments and cross-functional engineering collaboration.
Technical & Functional Skills
  • Strong automation testing fundamentals, including script development, framework maintenance, regression automation, integration testing, and end-to-end test execution.
  • Strong performance engineering fundamentals across load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing.
  • Ability to design robust and realistic performance test cases that effectively surface performance and reliability risks.
  • Hands-on experience with performance scripting and test execution using one or more relevant tools.
  • Strong analytical ability to interpret response times, throughput, resource utilization, concurrency behaviour, and system degradation trends.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience writing complex queries to analyse data populations and performance-related behaviour.
  • Working knowledge of relational and, ideally, NoSQL database concepts in performance analysis contexts.
  • Experience with APM and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, Grafana, or similar solutions.
  • Working knowledge of Linux platforms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and environment-level analysis.
  • Strong understanding of REST/SOAP services, APIs, web technologies, and application architecture.
  • Familiarity with programming or scripting in Java, Python, JavaScript, Groovy, or similar languages used in performance engineering.
  • Understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, networking, and runtime environments as they affect scalability and system behaviour.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and how performance testing can be embedded into broader engineering workflows.
  • Ability to convert performance findings into practical remediation recommendations for engineering and architecture teams.
AI-Related Expectations
  • Use AI tools to refine performance scenarios, expand workload variations, and accelerate creation of supporting SQL queries or validation logic.
  • Use AI support for log interpretation, defect clustering, and early bottleneck hypothesis generation during investigation cycles.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, hallucination risk, technical feasibility, and alignment with actual architecture and workload behaviour before use.
  • Follow approved privacy, security, and responsible-AI guidelines in all AI-assisted performance engineering activities.
SaaS & Cloud Awareness
  • Understanding of cloud-hosted and SaaS delivery models, including environment-based deployments, release cadence, scalability expectations, and shared-resource considerations.
  • Awareness of how containerized and distributed environments influence performance baselining, observability, and bottleneck diagnosis.
  • Familiarity with how configuration-driven changes, infrastructure elasticity, and multi-environment deployments can affect non-functional behaviour.
Communication & Collaboration
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to present technical findings, bottlenecks, and remediation recommendations clearly to developers, architects, product teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across distributed and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong reporting discipline and the ability to communicate performance risks with clarity, evidence, and business relevance.
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Personal Attributes
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability for non-functional quality outcomes.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and organized in execution.
  • Deeply analytical, evidence-driven, and structured in problem-solving.
  • Curious about new tools, techniques, and ways to improve performance engineering maturity.
  • Collaborative and credible in working with highly technical stakeholders.
  • Able to balance rigor, speed, and practicality in a delivery environment.
Preferred / Good to Have
  • Familiarity with containerized deployments, cloud environments, and performance testing in distributed architectures.
  • Experience embedding performance checks into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Exposure to Python for test scripting or analytics.
  • Testing or relevant technical certifications are an advantage.
  • Willingness to work with distributed teams and support implementation or release needs across time zones when required.
Why Join Us:
  • Work on business-critical insurance platforms where performance directly affects customer experience, operational stability, and release confidence.
  • Gain exposure to complex architectures, enterprise-scale transactions, and high-impact non-functional engineering challenges.
  • Build depth across performance engineering, observability, diagnostics, and cloud-aware quality practices.
  • Grow in an environment that is increasingly combining rigorous performance engineering with AI-assisted analysis and modern SaaS delivery expectations.

jobAdDetails.title: Database Administrator (DBA) - Oracle
jobAdDetails.description:
Title: Database Administrator (DBA) - Oracle
Location: Remote
 
Role Summary
Sapiens is transforming from a Services-based delivery model to a SaaS and AI-led platform business. This role is responsible for supporting, coordinating, and maintaining Oracle databases across our SaaS-hosted production environments — installation, configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, performance tuning, backup/restore, security, auditing, production support, and migration — for a multi-tenant/multi-customer platform running on AWS and Azure. We're looking for someone who thinks like a cloud-native operator, not a legacy on-prem administrator, and who can help modernize our database practices as we scale.
 
Responsibilities
  • Administer Oracle 19c+ databases across on-prem, AWS, and Azure — including RAC and Oracle OCI — in a multi-tenant/multi-customer SaaS environment
  • Install and configure new versions of Oracle Database Server; maintain database servers and processes, including system health/performance monitoring, to meet customer-facing SLAs for availability and security.
  • Independently analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in real time, including participation in an on-call rotation for production incidents.
  • Build and maintain automation (scripts, Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent Infrastructure-as-Code) to provision, patch, and monitor databases at scale across many customer instances; document and continuously improve processes.
  • Assist developers with complex query tuning and schema refinement.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance and support release/deployment activities after hours, within SLA-driven change windows.
  • Coordinate with the SaaS/Cloud Operations team on shared infrastructure, capacity planning, and incident escalation.
  • Apply AI tools to database administration workflows (e.g., troubleshooting, automation, documentation) and share this expertise with the team.
  • Identify, recommend, and promote best practices for multi-tenant data isolation, encryption, and compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) relevant to hosting insurance client data.
  • Mentor team members and share domain/technical expertise.
 
Experience & Education
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 4+ years of proven experience in Oracle Database Administration and maintenance.
  • 2+ years supporting databases in a multi-tenant or multi-customer SaaS/cloud-hosted production environment.
  • "Born in the Cloud" experience strongly preferred — prior work at a company whose products/infrastructure were architected natively for the cloud (SaaS-first), rather than migrated from legacy on-prem systems. This reflects the cloud-native mindset, automation-first habits, and platform-scale thinking we need as we complete our shift from a Services to a SaaS and AI-led model.
  • 3+ years' experience in the Insurance/Financial industry preferred
 
Technical Skills
  • Strong Oracle troubleshooting and performance-tuning ability, including TKPROF, EXPLAIN PLAN, OEM, and custom scripts.
  • Hands-on experience with backup/recovery using RMAN.
  • Experience with Data Pump, Export/Import, SQL*Plus, and SQL*Loader.
  • Proficiency in PL/SQL required; PG-SQL a plus. PostgreSQL experience a plus.
  • Cloud DBA experience with AWS preferred; Azure/OCI a plus, including managed database services (Amazon RDS, Azure Database).
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code/automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, or scripting) for provisioning and patching at scale.
  • Familiarity with cloud observability tooling (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Datadog, or similar) alongside OEM.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.
  • Experience with backend design and development.
  • Experience migrating data across various RDBMS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools/assistants in a technical workflow preferred.
 
Other
  • Incident resolution experience, including on-call/SLA-driven support.
  • Understanding of multi-tenant data isolation, encryption, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).
  • Understanding of DaaS and SaaS concepts, with hands-on experience in SaaS environments.
  • Cloud cost/capacity management experience (right-sizing, storage tiering) a plus.
  • Strong communication, accountability, and interpersonal skills; comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-changing environment.
 
 
At Sapiens, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment. We believe that diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences make us stronger and more innovative. We are committed to creating a culture where every individual is valued and can thrive regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, or any other characteristic.
 
Sapiens is an E-Verified & Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

row.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
row.description:
Sapiens is looking for a Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer to join our Corporate IT / Infrastructure team. You will design, build, remediate, and improve Sapiens’ corporate Azure infrastructure, translating target architectures and security standards into reliable production solutions. You will also act as hands-on delivery partner and technical deputy to the Lead Azure Infrastructure Engineer.
If you are a senior cloud infrastructure professional who wants deep technical ownership across Azure landing zones, networking, Entra ID/AD integration, and automation, this role offers direct influence over the corporate Azure foundation.

Location: Bengaluru
Working Model: Our flexible work arrangement combines both remote and in-office work, optimizing flexibility and productivity. 

What you’ll do:
The role is responsible for designing, deploying, remediating, and improving Sapiens’ corporate Azure infrastructure. The scope is corporate Azure only (non-product and non-customer environments). The ideal candidate is a senior technical specialist who takes difficult engineering work end to end, from design through handover and operations.

Key Responsibilities
Azure infrastructure engineering
•  Design, deploy, and troubleshoot management groups, subscriptions, virtual networks, routing, DNS, private endpoints, connectivity, compute, storage, and other corporate Azure services.
•  Implement and improve landing-zone configurations, Azure Policy initiatives, RBAC, tagging, resource standards, and environment guardrails based on agreed architecture.
•  Investigate and remediate security and configuration gaps, and raise architectural decisions that require the Lead Engineer’s approval.
Identity, security, and transformation
•  Implement and troubleshoot Entra ID and Active Directory integrations, synchronization, authentication, access provisioning, and related security controls.
•  Own assigned identity rationalization migration work packages, including dependency analysis, automation, testing, cutover, rollback procedures, and post-migration validation.
•  Implement least-privilege access, Conditional Access, privileged access processes, secrets and certificate practices, logging, and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with the CISO team.
Automation, delivery, and operational readiness
•  Create and maintain infrastructure-as-code modules and automation using Terraform or Bicep, PowerShell, and Git-based engineering practices.
•  Review HSO and internal implementation outputs for corporate Azure, identity, and Dynamics 365 integration dependencies, and escalate unresolved design risks.
•  Partner with the Cloud Engineer on complex incidents, root-cause analysis, performance, monitoring, backup and recovery, and operational improvements. Produce useful runbooks and diagrams.
•  Coordinate deployment interfaces and shared automation standards with the application DevOps team, without assuming ownership of application pipelines or the IDP.

Must Have Skills
•  7+ years of relevant infrastructure experience, including substantial hands-on engineering with enterprise Microsoft Azure.
•  Strong Azure networking, subscription and management group, landing-zone configuration, policy, RBAC, logging, and platform security experience.
•  Practical implementation experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and hybrid identity, with confidence troubleshooting identity and access failures.
•  Hands-on PowerShell plus Terraform or Bicep, with a good understanding of Git, change control, and repeatable deployment approaches.
•  Experience diagnosing complex cloud incidents, managing production changes, and delivering documented solutions from design through operations.
•  Ability to execute technical work independently, challenge assumptions, and mentor engineers while operating within approved architecture.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104). Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Security/Identity certifications are advantageous.
•  Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics/KQL, Defender for Cloud, backup and recovery, and cost optimization.
•  Experience supporting Dynamics 365-related infrastructure integrations or supplier-managed transformation programs.

What We Are Looking For
A senior, hands-on Azure infrastructure engineer who combines deep technical implementation skills with engineering leadership. You will be accountable for the detailed delivery and technical quality of assigned infrastructure changes. You will contribute architecture options, while the Lead Engineer holds overall authority for the corporate Azure target state and identity design. You will also provide technical escalation and coaching to the Cloud Engineer.
You will work closely with the Lead Azure Infrastructure Engineer, Azure Cloud Engineer, CISO and Security team, enterprise application owners, HSO, and the DevOps/Platform Engineering team.

Position Success
•  Agreed priority Azure gaps are closed, with tested configurations and change evidence.
•  Identity migration work packages are completed successfully, with dependency and rollback documentation.
•  Version-controlled IaC and reusable deployment patterns are used more widely for corporate Azure changes.
•  Recurring incidents and configuration drift are reduced, and operational handover quality improves.
•  Design decisions translate into secure, supportable production infrastructure.
•  Reporting line, employment location, grade, and operational coverage are to be confirmed through Sapiens’ hiring process.

About Sapiens:
Sapiens is a global leader in the insurance industry, delivering its award-winning, cloud-based SaaS insurance platform to over 600 customers in more than 30 countries. Sapiens’ platform offers pre-integrated, low-code capabilities to accelerate customers’ digital transformation. With more than 40 years of industry expertise, Sapiens has a highly professional team of over 5,000 employees globally. 
For More information visit us on www.sapiens.com. 
  
Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment that embraces individuals from diverse backgrounds. 
 
Disclaimer: Sapiens India does not authorise any third parties to release employment offers or conduct recruitment drives via a third party. Hence, beware of inauthentic and fraudulent job offers or recruitment drives from any individuals or websites purporting to represent Sapiens . Further, Sapiens does not charge any fee or other emoluments for any reason (including without limitation, visa fees) or seek compensation from educational institutions to participate in recruitment events. Accordingly, please check the authenticity of any such offers before acting on them and where acted upon, you do so at your own risk. Sapiens shall neither be responsible for honouring or making good the promises made by fraudulent third parties, nor for any monetary or any other loss incurred by the aggrieved individual or educational institution.  
In the event that you come across any fraudulent activities in the name of Sapiens , please feel free report the incident at sapiens to sharedservices@sapiens.com.

row.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
row.description:
Sapiens is looking for a Senior Azure Infrastructure Engineer to join our Corporate IT / Infrastructure team. You will design, build, remediate, and improve Sapiens’ corporate Azure infrastructure, translating target architectures and security standards into reliable production solutions. You will also act as hands-on delivery partner and technical deputy to the Lead Azure Infrastructure Engineer.
If you are a senior cloud infrastructure professional who wants deep technical ownership across Azure landing zones, networking, Entra ID/AD integration, and automation, this role offers direct influence over the corporate Azure foundation.

Location: Bengaluru
Working Model: Our flexible work arrangement combines both remote and in-office work, optimizing flexibility and productivity. 

What you’ll do:
The role is responsible for designing, deploying, remediating, and improving Sapiens’ corporate Azure infrastructure. The scope is corporate Azure only (non-product and non-customer environments). The ideal candidate is a senior technical specialist who takes difficult engineering work end to end, from design through handover and operations.

Key Responsibilities
Azure infrastructure engineering
•  Design, deploy, and troubleshoot management groups, subscriptions, virtual networks, routing, DNS, private endpoints, connectivity, compute, storage, and other corporate Azure services.
•  Implement and improve landing-zone configurations, Azure Policy initiatives, RBAC, tagging, resource standards, and environment guardrails based on agreed architecture.
•  Investigate and remediate security and configuration gaps, and raise architectural decisions that require the Lead Engineer’s approval.
Identity, security, and transformation
•  Implement and troubleshoot Entra ID and Active Directory integrations, synchronization, authentication, access provisioning, and related security controls.
•  Own assigned identity rationalization migration work packages, including dependency analysis, automation, testing, cutover, rollback procedures, and post-migration validation.
•  Implement least-privilege access, Conditional Access, privileged access processes, secrets and certificate practices, logging, and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with the CISO team.
Automation, delivery, and operational readiness
•  Create and maintain infrastructure-as-code modules and automation using Terraform or Bicep, PowerShell, and Git-based engineering practices.
•  Review HSO and internal implementation outputs for corporate Azure, identity, and Dynamics 365 integration dependencies, and escalate unresolved design risks.
•  Partner with the Cloud Engineer on complex incidents, root-cause analysis, performance, monitoring, backup and recovery, and operational improvements. Produce useful runbooks and diagrams.
•  Coordinate deployment interfaces and shared automation standards with the application DevOps team, without assuming ownership of application pipelines or the IDP.

Must Have Skills
•  7+ years of relevant infrastructure experience, including substantial hands-on engineering with enterprise Microsoft Azure.
•  Strong Azure networking, subscription and management group, landing-zone configuration, policy, RBAC, logging, and platform security experience.
•  Practical implementation experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, and hybrid identity, with confidence troubleshooting identity and access failures.
•  Hands-on PowerShell plus Terraform or Bicep, with a good understanding of Git, change control, and repeatable deployment approaches.
•  Experience diagnosing complex cloud incidents, managing production changes, and delivering documented solutions from design through operations.
•  Ability to execute technical work independently, challenge assumptions, and mentor engineers while operating within approved architecture.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104). Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Security/Identity certifications are advantageous.
•  Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics/KQL, Defender for Cloud, backup and recovery, and cost optimization.
•  Experience supporting Dynamics 365-related infrastructure integrations or supplier-managed transformation programs.

What We Are Looking For
A senior, hands-on Azure infrastructure engineer who combines deep technical implementation skills with engineering leadership. You will be accountable for the detailed delivery and technical quality of assigned infrastructure changes. You will contribute architecture options, while the Lead Engineer holds overall authority for the corporate Azure target state and identity design. You will also provide technical escalation and coaching to the Cloud Engineer.
You will work closely with the Lead Azure Infrastructure Engineer, Azure Cloud Engineer, CISO and Security team, enterprise application owners, HSO, and the DevOps/Platform Engineering team.

Position Success
•  Agreed priority Azure gaps are closed, with tested configurations and change evidence.
•  Identity migration work packages are completed successfully, with dependency and rollback documentation.
•  Version-controlled IaC and reusable deployment patterns are used more widely for corporate Azure changes.
•  Recurring incidents and configuration drift are reduced, and operational handover quality improves.
•  Design decisions translate into secure, supportable production infrastructure.
•  Reporting line, employment location, grade, and operational coverage are to be confirmed through Sapiens’ hiring process.
